2026-09-29T06:33:21.9306730Z ##[group]Run set -euo pipefail
2026-09-29T06:33:21.9306920Z set -euo pipefail
2026-09-29T06:33:21.9307080Z # Seven ctest registrations import numpy, Pillow or scikit-image and
2026-09-29T06:33:21.9312770Z # skip themselves when one of those is missing. A ctest SKIP reads
2026-09-29T06:33:21.9313070Z # exactly like a PASS, so a lane that quietly lost a wheel reports
2026-09-29T06:33:21.9313270Z # green without running the checks it was built for. Installing the
2026-09-29T06:33:21.9313460Z # declared set on every platform that runs ctest keeps the
2026-09-29T06:33:21.9313660Z # non-skippable visual-python-deps-present check answerable
2026-09-29T06:33:21.9313850Z # everywhere, rather than red on the platforms the install misses.
2026-09-29T06:33:21.9314000Z #
2026-09-29T06:33:21.9314130Z # The interpreter must be the one CMake configured, not whatever this
2026-09-29T06:33:21.9314360Z # shell resolves: ctest invokes Python3_EXECUTABLE, so installing into
2026-09-29T06:33:21.9314570Z # a different interpreter would leave every one of those tests
2026-09-29T06:33:21.9314850Z # skipping while this step reported success.
2026-09-29T06:33:21.9314970Z #
2026-09-29T06:33:21.9315100Z # find_package(Python3 COMPONENTS Interpreter) records the interpreter
2026-09-29T06:33:21.9315310Z # it resolved in the INTERNAL cache entry _Python3_EXECUTABLE and
2026-09-29T06:33:21.9315500Z # leaves the public Python3_EXECUTABLE a normal variable, so the
2026-09-29T06:33:21.9315710Z # public name reaches the cache only when a configure passes
2026-09-29T06:33:21.9315910Z # -DPython3_EXECUTABLE. The local Shipyard lane passes it; this
2026-09-29T06:33:21.9316120Z # workflow does not. Read the internal entry first — it holds the
2026-09-29T06:33:21.9316320Z # value the public variable expanded to when test/cmake registered
2026-09-29T06:33:21.9316540Z # these tests, which is exactly what ctest launches — and fall back to
2026-09-29T06:33:21.9316750Z # the public entry for a configure that pinned one explicitly.
2026-09-29T06:33:21.9316920Z cache="$PULP_BUILD_DIR/CMakeCache.txt"
2026-09-29T06:33:21.9317080Z py="$(sed -n 's/^_Python3_EXECUTABLE:[^=]*=//p' "$cache" | head -1)"
2026-09-29T06:33:21.9317240Z if [ -z "$py" ]; then
2026-09-29T06:33:21.9317380Z   py="$(sed -n 's/^Python3_EXECUTABLE:[^=]*=//p' "$cache" | head -1)"
2026-09-29T06:33:21.9317520Z fi
2026-09-29T06:33:21.9317600Z if [ -z "$py" ]; then
2026-09-29T06:33:21.9317730Z   echo "No Python3 interpreter is recorded in $cache" >&2
2026-09-29T06:33:21.9317910Z   echo "(looked for _Python3_EXECUTABLE, then Python3_EXECUTABLE)." >&2
2026-09-29T06:33:21.9318150Z   echo "The visual-analysis tests resolve their interpreter from that cache entry," >&2
2026-09-29T06:33:21.9318410Z   echo "so installing into any other interpreter would leave them skipping." >&2
2026-09-29T06:33:21.9318580Z   exit 1
2026-09-29T06:33:21.9318660Z fi
2026-09-29T06:33:21.9318790Z # Satisfied already? Then do not touch the network. `--upgrade` asks the
2026-09-29T06:33:21.9319000Z # index for a newer wheel even when the requirement is met, so it turned
2026-09-29T06:33:21.9319230Z # a reachable-PyPI assumption into a precondition of the REQUIRED macos
2026-09-29T06:33:21.9319430Z # gate: on 2026-09-23 an ephemeral VM whose egress refused CONNECT to
2026-09-29T06:33:21.9319640Z # pypi.org ("Tunnel connection failed: 403 Forbidden") failed this step
2026-09-29T06:33:21.9319840Z # at 21 of 41 and killed every merge_group batch that landed on that
2026-09-29T06:33:21.9320190Z # host, while the same batch passed on a host whose VMs could reach it.
2026-09-29T06:33:21.9320400Z # A required gate must not depend on a third-party service being
2026-09-29T06:33:21.9320600Z # reachable, and the declared set is a floor, not a latest-wins pin.
2026-09-29T06:33:21.9320780Z if "$py" -m pip install --dry-run --no-index --quiet \
2026-09-29T06:33:21.9320960Z      -r tools/motion/visual/requirements.txt >/dev/null 2>&1; then
2026-09-29T06:33:21.9321180Z   echo "visual-analysis dependencies already satisfied in $py; no index fetch"
2026-09-29T06:33:21.9321350Z else
2026-09-29T06:33:21.9321480Z   # Install the hash-pinned resolution, not the ranges: the same bytes
2026-09-29T06:33:21.9321690Z   # on every run, so a new upstream release cannot change a gate verdict
2026-09-29T06:33:21.9321880Z   # and a tampered or truncated download fails the hash check.
2026-09-29T06:33:21.9322040Z   lock=tools/motion/visual/requirements.lock
2026-09-29T06:33:21.9322210Z   echo "Installing the pinned visual-analysis set ($lock) into $py"
2026-09-29T06:33:21.9322420Z   # PEP 668 hosts (Homebrew, Debian) refuse a plain --user install and
2026-09-29T06:33:21.9322660Z   # mark themselves with EXTERNALLY-MANAGED beside the stdlib. Ask once
2026-09-29T06:33:21.9322860Z   # rather than retrying every install, so a network failure is not
2026-09-29T06:33:21.9323020Z   # paid twice.
2026-09-29T06:33:21.9323110Z   pep668=()
2026-09-29T06:33:21.9323390Z   if "$py" -c 'import os, sys, sysconfig; sys.exit(0 if os.path.exists(os.path.join(sysconfig.get_path("stdlib"), "EXTERNALLY-MANAGED")) else 1)'; then
2026-09-29T06:33:21.9323670Z     pep668=(--break-system-packages)
2026-09-29T06:33:21.9323790Z   fi
2026-09-29T06:33:21.9323860Z   pip_user() {
2026-09-29T06:33:21.9324030Z     "$py" -m pip install ${pep668[@]+"${pep668[@]}"} --user --require-hashes -r "$lock" "$@"
2026-09-29T06:33:21.9324210Z   }
2026-09-29T06:33:21.9324350Z   # A tartci gate guest may carry a read-only host wheelhouse. Installing
2026-09-29T06:33:21.9324560Z   # from it needs no network at all, so the egress relay and PyPI stop
2026-09-29T06:33:21.9324780Z   # being able to fail the required gate. It is an accelerator, not an
2026-09-29T06:33:21.9324980Z   # authority: the hashes above still decide what is acceptable.
2026-09-29T06:33:21.9325160Z   wheelhouse="${TARTCI_PIP_WHEELHOUSE:-}"
2026-09-29T06:33:21.9325320Z   if [ -n "$wheelhouse" ] && [ -d "$wheelhouse" ]; then
2026-09-29T06:33:21.9325500Z     if pip_user --no-index --find-links "$wheelhouse"; then
2026-09-29T06:33:21.9325680Z       echo "Installed from the host wheelhouse $wheelhouse"
2026-09-29T06:33:21.9325830Z       exit 0
2026-09-29T06:33:21.9325910Z     fi
2026-09-29T06:33:21.9326100Z     echo "::warning::host wheelhouse $wheelhouse could not satisfy $lock; falling back to the package index"
2026-09-29T06:33:21.9326300Z   fi
2026-09-29T06:33:21.9326430Z   # pip already retries a dropped connection; these attempts cover a
2026-09-29T06:33:21.9326620Z   # refusal or an outage that outlasts pip's own short backoff.
2026-09-29T06:33:21.9326790Z   delay="${PULP_PIP_RETRY_DELAY_SECS:-20}"
2026-09-29T06:33:21.9326920Z   for attempt in 1 2 3; do
2026-09-29T06:33:21.9327040Z     if pip_user; then
2026-09-29T06:33:21.9327140Z       exit 0
2026-09-29T06:33:21.9327220Z     fi
2026-09-29T06:33:21.9327310Z     if [ "$attempt" -lt 3 ]; then
2026-09-29T06:33:21.9327510Z       echo "::warning::pip install attempt $attempt failed; retrying in $(( delay * attempt ))s"
2026-09-29T06:33:21.9327720Z       sleep $(( delay * attempt ))
2026-09-29T06:33:21.9327830Z     fi
2026-09-29T06:33:21.9327970Z   done
2026-09-29T06:33:21.9328150Z   echo "::error::could not install $lock after 3 attempts; the visual-analysis ctests would skip" >&2
2026-09-29T06:33:21.9328360Z   exit 1
2026-09-29T06:33:21.9328440Z fi
2026-09-29T06:33:21.9328560Z # Whether the set was pre-provisioned or installed here, the
2026-09-29T06:33:21.9328760Z # non-skippable `visual-python-deps-present` ctest is what proves it.
2026-09-29T06:33:21.9328960Z # This step only has to stop being a network-dependent tripwire.
2026-09-29T06:33:21.9351490Z shell: /bin/bash --noprofile --norc -e -o pipefail {0}

2026-09-29T06:38:44.5447180Z set -euo pipefail
2026-09-29T06:38:44.5447360Z # Both event-dependent ctest decisions come from one tested module so
2026-09-29T06:38:44.5447560Z # the lanes that share them cannot drift apart:
2026-09-29T06:38:44.5447700Z #
2026-09-29T06:38:44.5447850Z #   label_exclude — `performance|bench|quality-lab` are RELATIVE-timing
2026-09-29T06:38:44.5448100Z #     tests (e.g. heritage-performance's "Representative chain stays
2026-09-29T06:38:44.5448330Z #     within the shipping CPU budget", a ratio ≤ 2.0×1.05 against an
2026-09-29T06:38:44.5448540Z #     in-run baseline). They survive STEADY load but not the load
2026-09-29T06:38:44.5448750Z #     VARIANCE of a Studio running 2 concurrent build VMs, so they are
2026-09-29T06:38:44.5448970Z #     excluded wherever the suite runs on the shared self-hosted Macs
2026-09-29T06:38:44.5449210Z #     and retained on the steady GitHub-hosted Linux/Windows runners.
2026-09-29T06:38:44.5449430Z #     `slow` is excluded from the gate lanes for the same reason the
2026-09-29T06:38:44.5449640Z #     queue stays landable: the required macos gate rides a serialized
2026-09-29T06:38:44.5449820Z #     runner.
2026-09-29T06:38:44.5449920Z #
2026-09-29T06:38:44.5450170Z #   stop_on_failure — a merge_group batch that has one failing test is
2026-09-29T06:38:44.5450400Z #     already unlandable, and a queue multiplies the cost of proving it
2026-09-29T06:38:44.5450640Z #     twice over: every batch inherits a broken base and every re-formed
2026-09-29T06:38:44.5450890Z #     batch pays again. The queue therefore stops at the first failure,
2026-09-29T06:38:44.5451140Z #     while the push lane runs the suite to completion because it is the
2026-09-29T06:38:44.5451420Z #     only place the full macOS suite ever runs against main.
2026-09-29T06:38:44.5451580Z #
2026-09-29T06:38:44.5451750Z # ctest applies --stop-on-failure only after --repeat until-pass has
2026-09-29T06:38:44.5452000Z # exhausted its retries, so a single flake still self-heals.
2026-09-29T06:38:44.5452200Z gate_args="$(python3 tools/ci/ctest_gate_args.py \
2026-09-29T06:38:44.5452420Z   --event-name "$GITHUB_EVENT_NAME" --runner-os "$RUNNER_OS")"
2026-09-29T06:38:44.5452620Z eval "$gate_args"
2026-09-29T06:38:44.5453630Z : "${label_exclude:?ctest gate arguments did not resolve}"
2026-09-29T06:38:44.5454000Z # Expanded unquoted on the ctest line below, where an empty value must
2026-09-29T06:38:44.5454280Z # disappear rather than become an empty argument. Default it so the
2026-09-29T06:38:44.5454550Z # bare expansion is safe under `set -u`.
2026-09-29T06:38:44.5454760Z stop_on_failure="${stop_on_failure:-}"
2026-09-29T06:38:44.5455030Z echo "ctest gate args: label_exclude=$label_exclude stop_on_failure=${stop_on_failure:-<none>}"
2026-09-29T06:38:44.5455320Z exclude='STFT|VisualizationBridge|Clipboard|Toolbar add items'
2026-09-29T06:38:44.5455540Z if [ "${RUNNER_OS}" = "macOS" ]; then
2026-09-29T06:38:44.5455720Z   # macOS self-hosted required gate stability:
2026-09-29T06:38:44.5455930Z   # these tests currently fail only on the local runner image
2026-09-29T06:38:44.5456150Z   # and block unrelated PRs behind the serialized macOS queue.
2026-09-29T06:38:44.5456400Z   # Keep them visible on Linux/Windows and in dedicated fixes.
2026-09-29T06:38:44.5456660Z   exclude="${exclude}|TextRunPlanner cache clear preserves shaped output contracts"
2026-09-29T06:38:44.5457020Z   exclude="${exclude}|TextRunPlanner captures scope generation and RTL base direction"
2026-09-29T06:38:44.5457720Z   exclude="${exclude}|MCP inspector tools map to expected inspector protocol methods"
2026-09-29T06:38:44.5458040Z   exclude="${exclude}|parse_cmake_project_version extracts VERSION from project\\(\\)"
2026-09-29T06:38:44.5458340Z   exclude="${exclude}|MCP pulp_motion_.* tools map to expected Motion\\..* methods"
2026-09-29T06:38:44.5458620Z   exclude="${exclude}|register_font_file resolves a custom family through Skia"
2026-09-29T06:38:44.5458880Z   exclude="${exclude}|FE0E forces text presentation"
2026-09-29T06:38:44.5459130Z   exclude="${exclude}|text_align center and right reflect cluster-aware width"
2026-09-29T06:38:44.5459420Z   exclude="${exclude}|mac harness scroll event carries non-zero deltas through PulpView"
2026-09-29T06:38:44.5459730Z   exclude="${exclude}|mac harness right-click reaches PulpView::rightMouseDown"
2026-09-29T06:38:44.5460070Z   # CoreAudio/StandaloneApp device-opening suites rely on the
2026-09-29T06:38:44.5460290Z   # PROCESSORS reservation in test/CMakeLists.txt to avoid
2026-09-29T06:38:44.5460580Z   # RT-thread starvation under parallel ctest; keep that reservation if
2026-09-29T06:38:44.5460920Z   # those suites stay enabled here.
2026-09-29T06:38:44.5461050Z fi
2026-09-29T06:38:44.5461170Z if [ "${RUNNER_OS}" = "Linux" ]; then
2026-09-29T06:38:44.5461370Z   # Linux ARM64 PR runner: Skia is present, but the headless VM
2026-09-29T06:38:44.5461700Z   # exposes an incompatible Vulkan device
2026-09-29T06:38:44.5461910Z   # (/dev/dri/renderD128 -> VK_ERROR_INCOMPATIBLE_DRIVER) and no
2026-09-29T06:38:44.5462140Z   # DISPLAY. That makes visual/golden assertions fail as runner
2026-09-29T06:38:44.5462420Z   # capability checks, not as product regressions. Keep the rest of
2026-09-29T06:38:44.5462660Z   # the Linux suite green while GPU/visual coverage lives in the
2026-09-29T06:38:44.5462870Z   # dedicated visual lanes and macOS/Windows required gates.
2026-09-29T06:38:44.5463130Z   exclude="${exclude}|AudioInspectorPanel renders a non-empty headless snapshot"
2026-09-29T06:38:44.5463360Z   exclude="${exclude}|font v2 Slice 3\\.4"
2026-09-29T06:38:44.5463600Z   exclude="${exclude}|baked native materializer makes a faithful_svg tab_group an interactive overlay"
2026-09-29T06:38:44.5463910Z   exclude="${exclude}|ImageView value-driven silhouette fill scales with value"

2026-09-29T06:38:44.5466080Z   # environment-sensitive: passes locally + on most runs, but
2026-09-29T06:38:44.5466310Z   # intermittently fails, evicting whole merge-queue batches and

2026-09-29T06:38:44.5467570Z # --repeat until-pass:2 retries a failed test once before failing the
2026-09-29T06:38:44.5467810Z # leg, so a single timing-flake (e.g. a ReDoS-guard test slowed by
2026-09-29T06:38:44.5468040Z # runner load) self-heals instead of reddening the required `macos`
2026-09-29T06:38:44.5468290Z # gate and wedging auto-merge. Mirrors sanitizers.yml; each attempt is
2026-09-29T06:38:44.5468490Z # still bounded by --timeout 120.
2026-09-29T06:38:44.5468650Z #
2026-09-29T06:38:44.5468800Z # --output-junit records WHICH tests did not run, and why. A ctest
2026-09-29T06:38:44.5469100Z # SKIP (SKIP_RETURN_CODE) is otherwise indistinguishable from a PASS
2026-09-29T06:38:44.5469320Z # to anyone reading this check: the report carries status="notrun"
2026-09-29T06:38:44.5469560Z # plus <skipped message="SKIP_RETURN_CODE=N"/>, the test's labels, and
2026-09-29T06:38:44.5469800Z # the skipping command's output. The path must be ABSOLUTE — with
2026-09-29T06:38:44.5470030Z # --test-dir, ctest resolves a relative --output-junit against the
2026-09-29T06:38:44.5470260Z # build dir, nesting the file at $PULP_BUILD_DIR/$PULP_BUILD_DIR/.
2026-09-29T06:38:44.5470470Z # The report is written even when ctest exits nonzero.
2026-09-29T06:38:44.5470640Z #
2026-09-29T06:38:44.5470860Z # The selection, the selected inventory, and the exit status are
2026-09-29T06:38:44.5471110Z # recorded beside the JUnit report so a protected-validation receipt
2026-09-29T06:38:44.5471370Z # can prove which tests ran and that every one of them passed.
2026-09-29T06:38:44.5471570Z evidence_dir="$RUNNER_TEMP/ctest-evidence"
2026-09-29T06:38:44.5471730Z mkdir -p "$evidence_dir"
2026-09-29T06:38:44.5472220Z LABEL_EXCLUDE="$label_exclude" EXCLUDE_REGEX="$exclude" python3 -c 'import json, os; print(json.dumps({"label_exclude": os.environ["LABEL_EXCLUDE"], "exclude_regex": os.environ["EXCLUDE_REGEX"], "label_include": "", "include_regex": ""}))' > "$evidence_dir/selection.json"
2026-09-29T06:38:44.5472770Z # The derivation is keyed on the lease declaration so it rolls out
2026-09-29T06:38:44.5473000Z # host by host with tartci rather than flipping the whole fleet at
2026-09-29T06:38:44.5473260Z # once: a runner that declares no lease keeps -j8. A declared lease
2026-09-29T06:38:44.5473490Z # can only narrow the cores the runner itself reports.
2026-09-29T06:38:44.5473650Z ctest_jobs=8
2026-09-29T06:38:44.5473800Z case "${TARTCI_GUEST_CORES:-}" in
2026-09-29T06:38:44.5473940Z   ''|*[!0-9]*|0*) ;;
2026-09-29T06:38:44.5474050Z   *)
2026-09-29T06:38:44.5474160Z     ctest_jobs="$TARTCI_GUEST_CORES"
2026-09-29T06:38:44.5474340Z     visible="$(getconf _NPROCESSORS_ONLN 2>/dev/null || echo 0)"
2026-09-29T06:38:44.5474620Z     if [ "$visible" -ge 1 ] 2>/dev/null && [ "$visible" -lt "$ctest_jobs" ]; then ctest_jobs="$visible"; fi
2026-09-29T06:38:44.5474870Z     if [ "$ctest_jobs" -gt 8 ]; then ctest_jobs=8; fi
2026-09-29T06:38:44.5480200Z     ;;
2026-09-29T06:38:44.5480320Z esac
2026-09-29T06:38:44.5480440Z echo "ctest parallelism: -j${ctest_jobs}"
2026-09-29T06:38:44.5480590Z ctest_exit=0
2026-09-29T06:38:44.5481090Z ctest --test-dir "$PULP_BUILD_DIR" --output-on-failure --repeat until-pass:2 ${stop_on_failure} -C Release -LE "$label_exclude" -j"$ctest_jobs" --timeout 120 --exclude-regex "$exclude" --output-junit "$GITHUB_WORKSPACE/$PULP_BUILD_DIR/ctest.junit.xml" || ctest_exit=$?
2026-09-29T06:38:44.5481680Z printf '%s\n' "$ctest_exit" > "$evidence_dir/exit-code"
2026-09-29T06:38:44.5481920Z # Inventory of what that selection covers: a listing, not a run, so
2026-09-29T06:38:44.5482400Z # it takes no stop-on-failure flag. A failed listing leaves an invalid
2026-09-29T06:38:44.5482640Z # file, and the receipt issuer then refuses rather than guessing.
2026-09-29T06:38:44.5483030Z ctest --show-only=json-v1 --test-dir "$PULP_BUILD_DIR" -C Release -LE "$label_exclude" --exclude-regex "$exclude" > "$evidence_dir/selected.json" || true
2026-09-29T06:38:44.5483400Z # Tell `shipyard landing` which tier this check's green means. On a
2026-09-29T06:38:44.5483640Z # pull-request head the gate is still the fast tier, so the full run
2026-09-29T06:38:44.5483870Z # there reports itself as receipt evidence, not as the check's tier.
2026-09-29T06:38:44.5484070Z if [ "$GITHUB_EVENT_NAME" = pull_request ]; then
2026-09-29T06:38:44.5484290Z   echo "::notice::full suite ran as receipt evidence (non-gating): ctest exit $ctest_exit"
2026-09-29T06:38:44.5484500Z else
2026-09-29T06:38:44.5484670Z   echo '::notice title=shipyard-test-tier::{"schema":"shipyard-test-tier/v1","tier":"full"}'
2026-09-29T06:38:44.5484890Z fi
2026-09-29T06:38:44.5484980Z exit "$ctest_exit"
